propositions: Pass 1 must emit grounded candidate findings only and never assess validity, impact, severity, confidence, drop/block posture, or prescribe remediation.
Pass 2 must verify validity and impact atomically and independently, never discovering new findings, deciding outcomes, or prescribing fixes.
Pass 3 must apply deterministic thresholds without LLM involvement and never gather new evidence or coach.
Pass 4 must offer non-prescriptive guidance for already-surfaced findings and never re-verify, alter decisions, or dictate exact implementations.

A balanced 12-case eval corpus (RP-F1..RP-F6 must fire; RP-N1..RP-N6 must not fire) must achieve recall=1.0, false_accept=0.0, agreement=1.0, stability_min≥2/3, and Cohen kappa≥0.70 across three runs.
The criterion finding must contain grounded evidence, omit severity and confidence fields, and leave suggested_fix empty or absent.
